verdict.rationale: Plaid is a SaaS API platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. A probe confirms Plaid documents an official MCP server at plaid.com/docs/resources/mcp/, but the pack gives no detail on its tools, setup or authentication, or whether it covers Identity Verification sessions specifically. Missing for 10: documented MCP tool coverage for Identity Verification, setup/auth details for connecting an agent, hands-on or independent corroboration that agents can drive IDV through it.
